import { Background } from "@legend-apps/presentation"
import { Text } from "react-native"
import { Journey, Camera, Box, Sphere, Material, Floor, KeyLight, Environment, PointLight, Orbs, Fog, Bloom, Vignette, Grain } from "slides:journey/Journey"

export const grid = { spacing: 2, intensity: 0.02 }

export const parts = <>
  <Material id="chrome" albedo="#c8ccd4" roughness={0.3} metal={1} rim={0} />
  <Material id="satin" albedo="#d9d9de" roughness={0.55} metal={0} rim={0} />
  <Material id="carbon" albedo="#18191d" roughness={0.18} metal={0.5} rim={0} />
  <Box material="chrome" position={[-4, 1, 0]} scale={[2, 2, 2]} emissive={0} />
  <Box material="satin" position={[0, 1.5, -1]} scale={[1.2, 3, 1.2]} emissive={0} />
  <Box material="carbon" position={[4, 0.75, 0]} scale={[3, 1.5, 1]} emissive={0} />
  <Sphere material="chrome" position={[0, 1, 2.5]} size={1} emissive={0} />
  <Box position={[4, 1.53, 0.51]} scale={[2.6, 0.06, 0.02]} color="#ff3b30" emissive={3} />
</>

export const look = <>
  <Fog density={0.012} color="#050506" />
  <Bloom intensity={0.9} threshold={1} /><Vignette amount={0.3} /><Grain amount={0.008} />
</>

<Background>
  <Journey id="lighting" background quality="auto" exposure={1.1}>
    <Camera shots={[{ step: 0, orbit: { center: [0, 1, 0], radius: 15, height: 5, speed: 0.05 }, fov: 40 }]} />
    {parts}
    <KeyLight position={[-10, 14, -8]} target={[0, 0, 0]} intensity={2.4} shadowSize={12} softness={2} />
    <Environment intensity={0.9} />
    <Floor y={0} color="#1c1d22" metal={0.2} roughness={0.3} size={200} grid={grid} />
    {look}
  </Journey>
</Background>

# Key light and shadows

<Text className="text-2xl text-zinc-400 text-center self-center">A shadow map falls across the floor and onto the parts</Text>

<Background>
  <Journey id="lighting" background quality="auto" exposure={1.1} enter={{ from: "previous", duration: 1.2 }}>
    <Camera duration={1.6} shots={[{ step: 0, position: [7, 3, 9], target: [0, 1.2, 0], fov: 34 }, { step: 1, position: [-6, 2.5, 8], target: [0, 1.2, 0] }]} />
    {parts}
    <KeyLight position={[-10, 14, -8]} target={[0, 0, 0]} intensity={2.4} shadowSize={12} softness={2} />
    <Environment intensity={[{ step: 0, value: 0 }, { step: 1, value: 1.2, duration: 1.6 }]} />
    <Floor y={0} color="#0a0a0c" roughness={0.08} size={200} grid={grid} />
    {look}
  </Journey>
</Background>

# Environment lighting

<Step at={1}><Text className="text-2xl text-zinc-400 text-center self-center">Metal and gloss pick up a soft studio environment</Text></Step>

---

<Background>
  <Journey id="lighting-floor" background quality="auto" exposure={1.1}>
    <Camera shots={[{ at: 0, position: [0, 2.4, 40], target: [0, 0.2, -40], fov: 44 }, { at: 0.5, position: [-1.5, 2.8, 22], target: [0, 0.2, -40], duration: 8, ease: "smoothstep" }]} />
    {parts}
    <KeyLight position={[8, 14, -10]} target={[0, 0, 0]} intensity={2} shadowSize={14} />
    <Environment intensity={0.8} />
    <Floor y={0} color="#0a0a0c" roughness={0.06} size={300} grid={grid} />
    <PointLight position={[0, 4, -30]} color="#ff3b30" intensity={30} range={40} />
    <Orbs count={40} colors={["#ffffff", "#ff3b30"]} radius={0.03} spread={[24, 6, 40]} position={[0, 3, -10]} seed={5} drift={0.2} emissive={3} />
    {look}
  </Journey>
</Background>

    <KeyLight position={[-10, 14, -8]} target={[0, 0, 0]} intensity={2.4} shadowSize={12} shadow="contact" />
